cohort: This study included 2 unrelated patients with an overlapping region of deletion at 1p21.3p21.2 and a third patient with a de novo recurrent unbalanced translocation.
finding: This case series reports two new cases of 1p21.3 deletions and one case of an unbalanced translocation t(8;12) in patients with syndromic obesity, suggesting these genetic variations may contribute to the phenotype.
